items.headline: No. 12 UCLA stays unbeaten at 6-0, tops Wisconsin 17-7 with a backup QB
items.description: — Backup quarterback Ty Dieffenbach was 22 of 33 for 264 yards in his first start as a Bruin, Wayne Knight and Anthony Woods each ran for touchdowns, and No. 12 UCLA beat Wisconsin 17-7 on Saturday night to improve to 6-0 for the first time since 2022.
